purpose: Single source of truth for quantitative control-model surfaces. UI, audit and tests consume this contract instead of restating fidelity, units and validity boundaries.

fidelityClasses.EQUATION_GRADE: Equation, units, assumptions and valid region are explicit and regression-testable.
fidelityClasses.PHYSICAL_APPROXIMATION: Numerical physical approximation with declared omitted effects.
fidelityClasses.TEACHING_SURROGATE: Causal teaching model; not a hardware timing/bandwidth claim.
fidelityClasses.HARDWARE_EVIDENCE: Claim closes only with provenance-bound board/scope/SFRA evidence.

visuals.validRegion: CCM at the stated L/C/R/ESR operating point
visuals.knownBoundary: DCM, DCR, switch loss, sample/ZOH/delay and board parasitics are outside this plant
boundaryTests: L or C increase lowers LC resonance

visuals.knownBoundary: RHP zero is non-minimum-phase; DCM, parasitics, current-mode effects and digital delay are outside this plant
derivation: factor LC poles and RHP zero

visuals.validRegion: current-loop frequencies where Vbus is approximately stiff
visuals.knownBoundary: line-cycle modulation, switching ripple, sensing and digital delay require separate factors

visuals.validRegion: outer-loop time scale well below the current loop
visuals.knownBoundary: 2*wline bus ripple is a forced disturbance, not this plant pole
boundaryTests: double-line frequency never becomes a plant pole

visuals.validRegion: declared Vin/n/Lo/Co/R point before commutation nonidealities dominate
visuals.knownBoundary: ZVS energy ratio is a teaching estimate and is not proof of hardware ZVS
boundaryTests: Lo or Co increase lowers resonance
derivation: map phase shift to ideal secondary duty

visuals.validRegion: steady-state gain sensitivity around the declared normalized operating point
visuals.knownBoundary: FHA curve is not dynamic loop phase, transient settling or a sampled-data plant
boundaryTests: fn=1 follows the equation-defined resonance gain

assumptions: LC resistive load or stiff-grid undamped LCL
visuals.knownBoundary: real LCL damping, grid impedance, dead time, PWM/ZOH and sampled delay require explicit extensions
boundaryTests: undamped LCL phase is continuous from -90 to -270
